title: Evidence Ledger Entry
description: A single claim entry in the evidence ledger, mapping a claim to its source reference

source_excerpt.description: Direct quote or close paraphrase from the source. null when source is not accessible.

confidence.description: How confident the writer is that the claim accurately represents the source. high=direct source access, low=memory-based

claim_type.description:
Type of the claim:
- factual: statements of fact
- attribution: attributing a position to an author
- method: describing a methodology
- result: reporting results
- interpretation: interpreting findings

audit_status.description: Audit status: pending=not yet audited, verified=passes audit, orphan=no source traceable, mismatch=claim misrepresents source
